title: Audit the stale KGEN and KAIOS BSC branding, explorer verification, ownership, and metadata lineage without external submission or authority claims
reason: PR 196 is an evidence-only branch that combines a safe read-only historical workflow with timestamped BSC explorer, deployed-contract, token metadata, logo, owner, creator, liquidity, and public-platform observations. The branch correctly denies signer or credential access, but its public verification actor, authenticated session, Company authorization, and publication state are not repository-bound; several observations are dated 2026-08-31 and a Standard-JSON candidate is identified only by a branch-reported local Windows path. Historical exact-head CI proves the old report is internally consistent, not that the external state is current or authorized. The safe bounded action is a current-main lineage audit only, with no report or workflow transplant and no external submission.

inventory.security_blocker: PR 196 lacks repository-bound proof of the source-verification submitter, authenticated BscScan session, ownership/controller/signer authority, or accepted token-info and logo publication.

blocking_findings: PR 196 is open, Draft, unmerged, non-mergeable, diverged, and 721 commits behind exact current main.

The KGEN and KAIOS source-verification states are branch-reported public observations; repository evidence does not establish who submitted them, which authenticated session was used, or whether the actor held Company authority.
The report records a 2026-08-31 public re-read; mutable explorer, token-information, logo, reputation, market, and listing state must be freshly re-read before any current claim.
The local Standard-JSON candidate is identified by a Windows path and hash but is not a repository blob, authenticated external submission receipt, or authority record.
Public creator, deployer, owner, treasury, registry, contract, pair, and wallet addresses do not prove current control, signer possession, ownership, employment, Life identity, or Company authority.
KGEN and KAIOS token information and logos were not submitted or published in the audited evidence; signed-out BscScan surfaces cannot establish an accepted ownership claim.
The reported KGEN/WBNB price and liquidity observation is time-sensitive and cannot become Canon, revenue, reserve, settlement, deployment, or custody evidence.
The old workflow is read-only and its historical run is green, but a branch-scoped stale workflow adds no current-main product capability and is not transplanted.
CI success cannot manufacture an external platform acceptance, a Human decision, reviewer identity, Company authority, signer control, or Mainnet permission.
No external verification, ownership, token-info, logo, listing, wallet, payment, transfer, approval, governance, deployment, or chain-state action is authorized by this audit.
safe_successor_requirements: Start from exact current main on a non-codex branch and preserve all protected Canon, CURRENT, Boot, contract, wallet, bridge, and workflow boundaries.

Treat explorer, contract metadata, verification, owner, creator, token-info, logo, reputation, supply, market, liquidity, and listing status as timestamped external observations with an explicit observation time and source URL.
Require repository-bound Human authority plus action-time confirmation before any authenticated BscScan, CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, wallet, contract, or listing submission.
Require an authenticated acceptance receipt and a post-action public re-read before changing a status from candidate or observed to submitted, accepted, verified, or published.
Never infer controller, signer, ownership, employment, Life identity, treasury, or Company authority from a public address, transaction, explorer page, GitHub authorship, or local file.
Never access credentials, generate ownership signatures, send transactions, dispatch workflows, call paid APIs, or mutate external or chain state as part of a lineage audit.

path_classification.disposition: Retain historical CI evidence only; do not add a stale branch-specific workflow to current main.
Do not publish 2026-08-31 observations or local-path candidates as current external state, acceptance, signer control, ownership, or Company authority.

acceptance: Both merge-base-to-audited-head paths appear exactly once with exact merge-base, audited-head, and current-main blob SHAs.
Classification counts sum to 2 and selected_candidate_count is exactly one.
PR 196 remains open, Draft, unmerged, and explicitly HOLD; this work order does not close or modify it.
No stale workflow or BSC branding, verification, ownership, metadata, logo, market, contract, wallet, or authority report is transplanted.
No UI or game code changes in this audit, so new browser screenshot QA is not applicable.

No Mainnet, payment, transfer, approval, ownership signature, credential access, publication, deployment, governance, controller, signer, operator, external agent, Worker/Life, paid API, workflow dispatch, or chain-state action is performed.
